reply.thought: Proceed to list orders and refunds status, then compute each customer net balance via net_balance tool and record payouts one per customer after confirming refunds are complete.

Get net balances for remaining customers (birch and cobalt) then record one payout per customer for their net balances.

Alpha refunds worker message says refunds are done; refunds list includes 130 and 133, and failed refund for 134 is not recorded, so net balances already reflect correct ledger state. Proceed to record payouts for acme, birch, cobalt.
